description: This file defines the Polymer.IronSelection class, which manages selection state for items, including methods for getting, setting, toggling, and clearing selections, with support for multi-selection.

classes.name: Polymer.IronSelection
classes.description: A class that manages selection state for a list of items, supporting single and multiple selection modes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the currently selected item(s). If multi is true, returns an array; otherwise, returns a single item or undefined.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all selections except those specified in the excludes array.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if a given item is currently selected.

methods.name: setItemSelected
methods.description: Sets the selection state for a specific item, adding or removing it from the selection list.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects an item; toggles if multi-selection is enabled.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of an item.
